excludedClaims: DPO removes preference collection as well as separate RM fitting and PPO.

An exact ideal reward reparameterization implies exact equivalence of finite-data, parameterized DPO training to an actual PPO run, without assumptions on the preference model, support or normalization.
The adaptive logistic weight guarantees prevention of degeneration or monotonically raises every chosen response's actual probability.
Beta is a learning rate, fixes a hard KL bound, or induces one universal monotone relation to per-step gradient size.
Two/four functional roles imply two/four equally sized live GPU replicas; fixed-reference log probabilities cannot be cached.
Unscoped historical win rates or IMDb sentiment frontiers establish universal DPO superiority, OOD generalization or model-family adoption.
IPO/SimPO/ORPO/KTO and online variants are only hyperparameter changes preserving standard DPO's exact objective.
